mission: EleutherAI builds openly licensed AI infrastructure (datasets, training code, evaluation tools, models with full checkpoints) and does interpretability and open-weight safety research. It aims to let researchers without frontier-lab resources do frontier work.

key_work.title: Pythia: A Suite for Analyzing LLMs Across Training and Scaling
key_work.plain_summary: Models released with every training checkpoint and the exact data seen, now a standard testbed for studying how capabilities form.

key_work.title: Deep Ignorance: filtering pretraining data (with UK AISI)
key_work.plain_summary: Removing hazardous material from pretraining data makes open models never learn it, a safeguard far harder to undo by fine-tuning.

key_work.title: LEACE: Perfect linear concept erasure in closed form
key_work.plain_summary: A mathematically exact way to erase a concept (like gender) from a model's internal representations.

key_work.title: LM Evaluation Harness
key_work.plain_summary: The standard open tool for evaluating language models, used behind the Open LLM Leaderboard.

key_work.title: The Common Pile v0.1: an 8TB dataset of public domain and openly licensed text
key_work.plain_summary: A large training dataset made only of openly licensed text.

key_work.title: What We Learned Trying to Catch AI Liars: An Aletheia's Quest Retrospective
key_work.plain_summary: Lessons from a lie-detection competition for language models.

warnings.text: Once model weights are public, safeguards cannot rely on API monitoring or post-training fixes that fine-tuning can remove.
Reported benchmark numbers depend heavily on prompting and scoring details.

recommendations.text: Make open-weight models safe at the data and training level (filter hazardous pretraining data).
Study model internals over the course of training, not just the finished model.
Keep data, code and models open so independent researchers can check AI.
